orchestraManifest: the crop-analytics orchestra contract

Source: R/orchestraManifest-package.R
orchestraManifest-package.Rd

A single installable home for the artefacts that let independently developed analytics components exchange inference results without knowing anything about each other beyond this contract.

Details

The package has four faces. The manifest itself (orchestra_manifest) is a versioned, integrity-hashed, provenance-tracked S7 record of one inference. The consumer guard (verify_manifest and consume_manifest) turns silent schema drift and silent payload tampering into loud, early failures. The provenance vocabulary (grounding_token, combine_grounding) propagates a worst-case grounding label so a verdict resting on an unverified fact is labelled as such. The refusal contract (is_orchestra_refusal, is_orchestra_decline) lets a gate recognise any component's structured refusal or abstention without enumerating component classes.
